deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 12% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 49% last year; 17%/yr over 3 years — the market expects a slowdown from its recent pace.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 55% (3 years ago 22%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $55 a year after tax.

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $132.0B, up 200% from a year ago — about 0.9× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $29.7B, up 14% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Inventory up 195% vs quarterly sales up 58% (days of inventory 27 → 52). Products may be building up unsold — a warning sign in chip cycles.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 17%/yr over 3 years and 10%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 9% vs a 5-year range of 4–9% (median 6%): near the top of a fairly narrow range.
deeper.margin_position: near the top of a fairly narrow range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $10.1B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($8.5B buybacks + $1.6B dividends) = 4.5% of the company's market value. Share count down 5.0% from a year ago (buybacks outpacing stock pay).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $28.21, up 45% in 90 days (up 14% in the last 30); 1 analyst raised, 0 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $25.91, up 41% in 90 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Infrastructure Solutions Group 68% of sales, up 89%; Client Solutions Group 32% of sales, up 20%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +203% vs a year ago · $17.45 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 203% vs sales 58% (latest quarter vs a year earlier): profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 5 quarters running, by growing margins (1% → 31%): analysts keep underestimating it.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +58% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $151.2B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 58% vs a year earlier and speeding up (from 39% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $9 of operating profit, up from $7 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: Only 75% of reported profit became spare cash, usually because of heavy investment; worth watching.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 20× last year's profit (higher than 57% of the last 5 years); only 11× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Nov 24; analysts expect EPS of $6.55, up 153% from a year ago. It usually moves about 13% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.
